implementation_notes: Crosswalk field sic2_from_printed is split on ';' as well as ',' (the supplied file uses ';').
Census codes are matched as integers (crosswalk codes are zero-padded strings, V43 is numeric).
Out-of-range codes on reversed 1..k items (e.g. a stored 0 on V233) are treated as missing.
HC3: rows with hat value >= 1 - 1e-8 contribute zero (A1); their count is model_stats.csv n_leverage_one.

Only industry dummies are ever dropped (A5), and industry collinearity is resolved by the QR before the residual-df check with no early exit on n; nested_tests.csv carries status/error columns (A5/A6) and restricted_dropped_columns (A6: dummies dropped in the restricted refit, kept even when that refit failed).
Failure entries below carry dropped_columns / restricted_dropped_columns where a fit dropped industry dummies before failing (A6).

Influence: a failed original model yields one failed row per estimation-sample record; an empty sample yields no row (A6); a placeholder row with deleted_V1 null is written only when the sample is unknown (whole-spec failure).
Missing values are NA in the CSV files and null in this JSON file (A6).
See code/README.md for the full list of interpretations and the v1.1 / v1.2 change lists.
